newsitem.title: USA: Esprit sees Q2 revs up, margins down.
newsitem.headline: Esprit sees Q2 revs up, margins down.

text.p: Esprit Telecom Group Plc said Wednesday it expects strong revenue growth for the second quarter, ended March 31, but gross profit and margins are likely to be down significantly from the first quarter.
It said it expects to report revenue of about 10.3 million stg for the second quarter, up from 6.0 million stg a year earlier and 8.6 million stg in the fiscal 1997 first quarter.
Gross profit for the first quarter was about 1.9 million stg, or 21.8 percent of revenue.
Esprit said its gross margin was hurt by a higher proportion of wholesale traffic and severe margin pressure on specific routes.
It also cited network capacity shortages that caused traffic to overflow to higher-cost routes, and continued unfavorable foreign currency exchange rate movements.
"However, lower than anticipated SG&A costs are expected to partially offset the decline in gross profit," the company said.
Esprit is an independent European telecommunications service provider.
